message.content:
**Inactive (non‑active) ingredients in Tylenol Extra Strength Caplets**

- Carnauba wax  
- Corn starch (modified starch)  
- FD & C Red No. 40 aluminum lake (color)  
- Hypromellose (coating agent)  
- Magnesium stearate (lubricant)  
- Polyethylene glycol (plasticizer)  
- Powdered cellulose (microcrystalline cellulose)  
- Pregelatinized starch  
- Propylene glycol (solvent)  
- Shellac (film former)  
- Sodium starch glycolate (disintegrant)  
- Titanium dioxide (colorant)  

These ingredients are listed on the FDA‑approved label for “TYLENOL EXTRA STRENGTH CAPLET” in the DailyMed database【1†L119-L125】【1†L140-L146】.
